title: Hearty Malty Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A malty and crisp Argentinian dish featuring shio-koji, perfect for a festive dinner, this recipe is low-fat-friendly and full of flavor. The combination of beef, malty flavors, and Argentinian spices creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, malt syrup, olive oil, garlic, parsley, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 130 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Temper the skewers by letting them sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before grilling.
